delights: It tells me when it failed instead of pretending: "Tried 5 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance - closest was \"Seswaa\" (landed 508 kcal vs a 319 target)." I would rather be told than be handed a tidy lie.

Gluten-free by construction, not by luck: across 97 distinct ingredients in 35 slots there is no wheat, bread, pasta, flour, barley or rye anywhere - every starch is rice, quinoa or potato. And it correctly kept "Egg Plants 200g" in the Baba Ghanoush rather than stripping aubergine because the word looks like my egg allergy.
The one swap that landed was exactly right: "High-Protein Shrimp & Onions with Potato" replaced the sherry breakfast and took that meal from 15.6g fat to 5.6g, with no warning attached.

defects.what: There is no breakfast anywhere in the week. Day 0 opened with prawns and cooking sherry as my first meal of the day - I am postpartum and will not drink that at 7am.
defects.snippet: Garlicky prawns with sherry - ing: Olive Oil 15g, Garlic 3g, Shrimp 150g, Dry sherry 7g, Parsley 11g

defects.what: Other 'breakfasts' are a courgette-and-bean soup and a plate of meatballs; nothing in seven days reads as a morning meal.
defects.snippet: day 2: Summer Pistou / day 3: Algerian Kefta (Meatballs)

defects.what: I asked for recomp with a goal weight 0.1 kg below my current weight, and the engine gave me a 2 lb/week cut at 1533 kcal - at or below my resting burn. That is not a recomp.
Half the week does not fit its own numbers: 18 of 35 slots carry a tolerance warning, and the days run 1549-1860 kcal against a 1533 target (mean 1664, Day 2 is +327).
defects.snippet: closest was "Avocado Chips & Jerky" (landed 352 kcal vs a 96 target)

defects.what: My stated cuisine preferences were ignored - japanese and thai got exactly one dish out of 35, and 13 slots are the same nameless formula plate with cuisine None.
defects.snippet: High-Protein TVP & Onions with Rice / High-Protein Shrimp & Bell Peppers with Quinoa / High-Protein White Fish & Cucumber with Quinoa (cuisine=None)

defects.what: Hidden-gluten items are served with no warning for a coeliac. Most supermarket oyster sauce is thickened with wheat, and stock cubes and marinated jerky are the classic traps.
defects.snippet: Thai beef stir-fry - ing: Vegetable Oil 3g, Beef 150g, Red Chilli 4g, Oyster Sauce 25g, Basil Leaves 4g

defects.what: I said low-fat, and the snack rotation is pork rinds, beef jerky and avocado chips - Cacik is 60% fat, Avocado Chips & Jerky 58%, Jerky & Pork Rinds 55%.
defects.snippet: Jerky & Pork Rinds Snack Plate - ing: Beef jerky 30g, Pork rinds 15g

defects.what: Two dinners are dips eaten as a meal - a bowl of watered-down yogurt, which the app itself scores as a protein miss.
defects.snippet: Jajek - ing: Yogurt 285g, Cold Water 135g, Garlic 2g, Salt 1g, Dried Mint 1g, Cucumber 60g ... (delivered 20g protein vs a 61g target)

defects.what: Not affordable for someone at home between jobs: $221.31 of servings for the week, $31.62 a day, including a specialty-butcher goat trip.
defects.snippet: Jamaican Curry Goat - $21.62 per serving; Seswaa $11.34 x2; four shrimp dishes at $10-11

defects.what: The swap call rejected the obvious payload - the recipeId the alternates call had just handed me - with a message about ingredients I never sent.
defects.snippet: PUT /apply {"recipeId":"cmrul4e6k0066wl6862s2m9jl"} -> 400 {"error":"a slot needs at least one ingredient"}

defects.what: Cooking load is five separate dishes every single day with no leftovers or batch cooking - 120 minutes on Day 1.
No shopping list came with the week; the plan's groceryList is empty.

followUp.action: Asked for alternates to replace the prawns-and-sherry breakfast on Day 0, then swapped one in
followUp.howItWent: Alternates returned 200 but offered me three shrimp dishes - Shrimp & Onions with Potato, Shrimp & Bell Peppers with Potato, Shrimp & Bell Peppers with Rice - differing only by which vegetable, and two of them already appear elsewhere in my week; all three were matchPct 100, so the macros were perfect and the choice was meaningless. The apply then 400'd on {"recipeId":...} with "a slot needs at least one ingredient" and only worked when I posted the whole alternate object back, after which the swap persisted correctly and dropped that meal from 15.6g fat to 5.6g.

verdict: My coeliac and egg walls were genuinely respected - not one gram of wheat or egg in 97 ingredients, and it was smart enough to know aubergine is not egg - but the week has no breakfast, serves me cooking sherry at dawn and pork rinds as a low-fat snack, ignores the japanese and thai food I said I liked, runs 8% over my calories on a target that was wrong for a recomp to begin with, and costs $31 a day.
